entities.name: Lucayan Enslavement and Island Depopulation
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Spanish slavers systematically captured and deported the Lucayan population to Hispaniola to work in gold mines and on plantations. By 1520, the Bahamas were virtually uninhabited — an estimated 40,000 Lucayans had been enslaved or killed.
